sights.w: Liège's main playhouse in the neoclassical Société libre d'Émulation building (Julien Koenig, 1934–39; the 1779 society's first hall was burned in the 1914 reprisals) — classified 1998, rebuilt by Pierre Hebbelinck & Pierre de Wit and reopened Oct 2013 with a 557-seat hall, bar and the Baci restaurant.
